question: What power arises from continually contemplating a smoke-colored form?
premises: A smoke-colored form is to be contemplated always.
The power to shake the triple world is asserted.
inference: By always contemplating a smoke-colored form, one may shake the triple world.
uncertainties: the object contemplated as smoke-colored is not explicitly named in this verse
plain_english: O beloved, by always contemplating a smoke-colored form, one may shake the triple world.
